headline: BI Rate Rises to 6%, BI Governor: Aimed at Safeguarding the Rupiah and Inflation!
summary: Bank Indonesia raised its benchmark rate to 6% at its board meeting to support the rupiah and anticipate inflation in 2026-2027. Macroprudential policy was also strengthened.
why: Bank Indonesia is the central bank of Indonesia. Its policy rate influences borrowing costs, bond yields and the rupiah.
why_moved: The rate increase is aimed at supporting the rupiah and anticipating inflation, according to the central bank's stated goals.
original_headline: BI Rate Naik Jadi 6%, Bos BI: Demi Jaga Rupiah dan Inflasi!
